page.notes: Marginal notes are in the right margin and were transcribed in the order they appear beside the text; some are heavily blurred, and their exact wording and line breaks are uncertain. Several words in the notes ("Papa rumquondam", "fastus: velut", "Imppp.") are doubtful. The margin note for Alexander III and Hadriani IV is partly illegible.
